name: Breaker control-plug engaged indication
aliases: switchgear Breaker position and status interfaces
summary: Reports the documented connection of the secondary control plug.
description: Reports the documented connection of the secondary control plug. Breaker status indications describe the operating mechanism, the removable truck or the health of a supporting system. These signals are related but are not interchangeable: an open breaker can still have its truck connected to live bus contacts.

In a switchgear control schematic, the bay controller compares independent status contacts before displaying a position or allowing another operation. The signal labels explain which physical state each contact represents. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Control-plug contact” at the input and “Secondary connection status” at the output. Plug engagement does not prove every circuit healthy.

Keep contact reference conditions, terminal numbers and interpretation logic together. Distinguish a mechanically operated indication from a measured current or voltage condition. The functional block is an independent explanation of this named application. Equipment-specific ratings, terminal connections and operating conditions must be established in the project documentation.
